name: Together AI
look: Alternating dark and light bands with no in-between greys, mono-caps labels throughout, and a three-colour gradient ribbon as the only decoration.

hero.title: Run and fine-tune open models at scale
hero.sub: Two hundred open models on an inference stack built for throughput, plus GPU clusters when you need to train something of your own.

features.title: Inference, fine-tuning and clusters
features.sub: The three things you need to actually ship with open models, priced per token or per GPU-hour.

items.title: Fast inference
items.body: A custom kernel stack that serves open models several times faster than a naive deployment.

items.title: Fine-tuning
items.body: LoRA or full fine-tunes on your data, returning weights you can download and run elsewhere.

items.title: GPU clusters
items.body: Reserved H100 and H200 capacity with InfiniBand, by the week or by the month.

items.title: OpenAI-compatible
items.body: A drop-in endpoint, so switching costs one base-URL change.

items.title: Your weights are yours
items.body: Fine-tuned weights are downloadable. There is no lock-in on the artefact you paid to create.

items.title: Transparent pricing
items.body: Per-token rates published per model, and per-GPU-hour rates published per instance type.

showcases.title: Throughput is the whole product
showcases.body: A custom serving stack with speculative decoding and continuous batching. The published benchmarks include the configuration and the harness, so you can reproduce them rather than take our word for it.

showcases.title: We contribute back
showcases.body: The kernels and the training recipes are published. Several of the optimisations in this stack started as papers we released, and the reference implementations stay open.

gallery.title: MODELS
gallery.sub: Two hundred open models, served and benchmarked.

testimonial.quote: They published the benchmark harness, so we ran it ourselves and got their number within two percent. Nobody else we evaluated would even tell us the batch size.
testimonial.name: Aditi Sharma

pricing.title: PRICING
pricing.sub: Per token for inference, per GPU-hour for clusters. All published.

items.q: Can I download a model I fine-tuned?
items.a: Yes, always. Fine-tuned weights are yours to download and run anywhere, including on hardware that is not ours.

items.q: How do the speed claims hold up?
items.a: The benchmark harness and configuration are published alongside the numbers. Run it yourself — customers regularly do, and the numbers hold.
Yes. Changing the base URL and the model name is usually the whole migration.

items.q: What is the minimum cluster commitment?
items.a: One week. Most training runs take longer, but there is no annual contract required to get InfiniBand-connected H100s.

cta.title: START BUILDING
cta.sub: Twenty-five dollars of credit, no card, two hundred models.

footer.tagline: Run and fine-tune open models at scale.

notes: A single black CTA pill carries every conversion target. Mint and white pill variants belong to hero contexts only.
A three-colour gradient ribbon is the entire decorative system — used once as the hero graphic and never reduced to a swatch elsewhere.
All-caps mono labels appear everywhere: eyebrows, button labels, section titles and table headers.
Card chrome is lightly rounded at 4px. Full pills appear only on the floating chat launcher.
Dual surface mode alternates dark and light bands with no in-between greys; the one soft surface marks table-header rows.
